description.value: Foolish Wine is a small, family-run winery founded by the Coghill and Main families — the same duo behind Neighbourhood Brewing — situated in Oliver's District Wine Village in the heart of BC wine country. The winery produces terroir-driven, old-world-inspired wines from their North Naramata home vineyard and carefully selected Okanagan growers, releasing modest case quantities from a boutique cellar. The Village setting also hosts live music events, making it a lively stop for cyclists riding through the South Okanagan.
